title: StreamBIM credential storage and FTP transfer security
notes: Credentials stored in Windows Credential Manager (DPAPI), FTP uses TLS 1.2 Explicit encryption. No explicit certificate validation callback on FTP client; password held as plaintext string in memory via UserCredentials record. No credential leakage in logs. Git history clean of hardcoded secrets.

title: Dalux API key handling - broken credential lookup in upload and minor HttpClient gaps
notes: DaluxCloudUpload passes args.ApiKey (default: 'Dalux API Key') instead of looked-up apiKey variable to DaluxApiService. HttpClient has no timeout or certificate validation callback. Error messages include base URL.

title: Git history audit - no secrets found
notes: Full git log -p -S audit across all branches for password, secret, key, apiKey, PRIVATE KEY, connection, Token/AuthToken/Bearer/api_token - no secrets found in history. Repository is clean.

title: LISPRunner arbitrary AutoCAD Lisp script execution
notes: Arbitrary Lisp code execution from user-supplied file paths or inline content. SendStringToExecute() called with no sanitization. Both script-file and inline modes allow full AutoCAD Lisp API access.

title: RunCommand arbitrary AutoCAD command injection
notes: Arbitrary AutoCAD command execution from user-supplied input. SendCommand() called directly with no sanitization, whitelist, or validation. Multi-line input allows command chaining.

title: DaluxCloudDownload path traversal via server-supplied relative path
notes: Server-supplied file.RelativePath and file.FileName used directly in Path.Combine without validation. Supply-chain attack vector: compromised Dalux API could inject ../ sequences.

title: Base URL exposed in API error messages
notes: HandleException<T> method includes _baseUrl ('https://node1.field.dalux.com/service/api') in error messages returned to client. Same code exists in DaluxCloudDownload/Services/DaluxApiService.cs.

title: Tekla IFCExport path traversal via unvalidated output file path
notes: Output file path from XML config or SaveFileField override goes through Path.GetFullPath() with no traversal validation. Directory.CreateDirectory() auto-creates parents. Inconsistent with Revit DWGExport/NWCExport which sanitize filenames via Regex.Replace.

title: Tekla five file operation extensions - safe assessment
notes: Security review confirms no injection, path traversal, or command execution risk. All five extensions use only SDK APIs and hardcoded string literals. No user-typed file paths or command strings.

title: Navisworks SaveDocumentAs path traversal via unvalidated directory creation and file path information disclosure
location: src/Navisworks/dotnet/SaveDocumentAs/SaveDocumentCommand.cs line 8-12 and line 15, OpenDocument/OpenDocumentCommand.cs line 26, ClashDetectiveRunner/ClashDetectiveRunTestCommand.cs lines 39, 77, 84
notes: Directory.CreateDirectory() called on unvalidated path from SaveFileField. Full file paths echoed in success messages by OpenDocument and SaveDocumentAs. Full exception details including stack traces logged to Trace in ClashDetectiveRunner.
